sourceNotes: Summarized from FreeCAD PartDesign documentation and Open CASCADE Technology overview documentation.
cadRules: Represent each manufacturable part as a stable feature tree rather than an anonymous primitive.
Prefer sketch-driven extrude, revolve, cut, hole, fillet, and chamfer features for mechanical parts.
Keep datum planes, named faces, and coordinate systems stable for downstream assembly constraints.
STEP export should preserve assembly structure when the CAD kernel supports it.
Generated geometry should avoid non-manifold solids, self-intersections, and zero-thickness faces.
